ticker_news.title: Dow Jones Bulls Await Fed Catalyst to Push Past 45K Barrier
ticker_news.description: Dow Jones investors are anticipating Fed Chair Powell's Jackson Hole speech as a potential catalyst to break through the 45,000 resistance level. Tech stocks have experienced recent weakness, but sector rotation in financials, energy, and consumer sectors may help cushion market volatility.
ticker_news.author: Fawad Razaqzada

ticker_news.title: S&P 500: Is a Deeper Correction Ahead?
ticker_news.description: The S&P 500 is experiencing potential market weakness ahead of the Jackson Hole symposium, with investors cautious about potential hawkish comments from Fed Chair Powell. Market sentiment remains relatively bearish, with low volatility and concerns about potential correction.
ticker_news.author: Sunshine Profits

SPY.title: Fed Minutes Reveal Hawkish Officials Still In Control: Economist Says 16% Effective Tariffs Put Inflation 'On The Front Burner'
SPY.description: Federal Reserve minutes show officials maintaining a hawkish stance on inflation, with tariffs and potential price pressures keeping interest rates steady. The committee believes inflation risks outweigh unemployment risks, with a potential rate cut unlikely in the near term.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra

QQQ.title: If You'd Invested $1,000 in Bitcoin (BTC) 5 Years Ago, Here's How Much You'd Have Today
QQQ.description: A $1,000 investment in Bitcoin in August 2020 would be worth $9,784 today, significantly outperforming traditional index funds like Vanguard 500 and Invesco QQQ, despite experiencing high volatility.
QQQ.author: Anders Bylund
